reading.action: Floor 1: training montage — practice Ember Burst at the rubble to exhaustion, meditate Focus back, repeat
reading.result: SKILL ADVANCED: Ember Burst Novice(4) -> Apprentice(7). Capability gate: drilling a rehearsed motion vs STATIC rubble demonstrates Apprentice (anchor 7, the 'competent in the yard' band) — 3 effective alpha=0.5 roll-ups asymptote to 7; drilling CANNOT cross into Journeyman (10+), which needs reliable-when-it-counts/live use the yard can't certify. Hidden (fog, no foreshadow): Apprentice = the counterfeit band (yard-competence, untested under live pressure); he feels ready. Focus ground to exhaustion then meditated back to full 104; HP/Stamina unchanged. Ember Affinity +1 (anti-farm: one tick for whole montage; drilling pumps the SKILL, not the affinity) -> 8. System fires SKILL ADVANCED panel.
